title: Wellness Membership Forfeited Sessions and Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Fees
content:
Revenue Cycle memo on how a patient's Wellness Membership history bears on the late-cancellation fee of an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The late-cancellation membership-miss share is 150 percent where the patient's Wellness Membership history shows two or more maintenance sessions forfeited in the three months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than three whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one such forfeited session, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the late-cancellation basis and multiplies it.

**Records read.** The forfeited maintenance session entries in the patient's Wellness Membership history, by their dates.

| Forfeited maintenance sessions in the three months up to the assessment date | Membership-miss share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 150 percent |
| exactly one | 125 percent |
| none, or no Wellness Membership history | 100 percent |

**Counting at the edge (hypothetical dates, assessment on 20 May).** A forfeited session dated 21 February counts: fewer than three whole months separate it from 20 May. One dated 20 February does not: three whole months separate it from 20 May.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** One forfeited session in the period on a late-cancellation basis of USD 40.00: 125 percent of USD 40.00 is USD 50.00.
